description: tests/message_smoke_tests.rs:851-885 (message_update_with_read_disposition_other_serialises_correctly). The test sends "voice-listened" — which is a spec example value (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 line 363). The spec policy is 'Unrecognized values MUST be stored as-is', which is broader than the two example strings. A regression that special-cased exactly the two spec examples would still pass this test. Add a second assertion with a non-spec-example string like "acmeCorpPrivateStatus" to verify the catch-all behaviour.
title: ReadDisposition::Other only tested with spec-example string, not arbitrary
